sentences.en: The company specializes in food processing and packaging.
sentences.zh: 这家公司专门从事食品加工和包装业务。

sentences.en: Food processing techniques have improved the shelf life of fruits and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 食品加工技术提高了水果和蔬菜的保质期。

sentences.en: They use advanced methods for food processing to ensure safety and quality.
sentences.zh: 他们使用先进的食品加工方法以确保安全和质量。
